title: Evidence shows zero on read failure and knowledge inbox invents kind risk and source

delivered: Updated EvidenceExplorerList in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx to check whether the management_evidence surface is ok; when management_evidence is not ok (unavailable, degraded, or unreturned), the five metric cards render Unavailable instead of numeric 0 and the empty-table row renders a distinct unavailable message (evidence-route-unavailable) instead of the no-rows message, while a true empty ok response continues to render 0 in the five metric cards and the no-rows message (evidence-route-empty).

Updated adaptManagementEvidenceOverview and adaptEvidenceListItem in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts to map BFF /bff/management/evidence rows from EVIDENCE-OWNER-LIST-BOUNDED-20261104 (title / citation_label, source_type / metadata.source_class, captured_at / available_time / event_time, top-level page_info, top-level meta.surfaces, and null-safe asFiniteNumber).

Added page_info pagination support in mgmt.evidence.overviewLiveOnly and EvidenceExplorerList so operators can reach rows beyond the first page via page_info.next_page_token while displaying page_info.total as the Total metric.

Removed fabricated defaults in src/lib/bff-v1/managementConsoleReads.ts (adaptKnowledge, toKnowledgeKind, toKnowledgeRisk): kind is read from inboxType without defaulting to research_note, source is read from sourceDataset without defaulting to pantheon-bff, missing risk remains undefined instead of defaulting to low, and missing timestamp remains empty string instead of fabricating a timestamp.

Updated KnowledgeInboxPage in src/management/pages/phase2/KnowledgeInbox.tsx to distinguish BFF empty ok responses (rendering knowledge.empty / data-testid=knowledge-inbox-empty) from read failures or unavailable surfaces (rendering knowledge.unavailable / data-testid=knowledge-inbox-unavailable), to render the existing Unavailable RiskBadge when risk is missing, and to omit fabricated time separator/placeholder when ts is empty.

Added bilingual i18n keys in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts for knowledge.unavailable, mgmt.evidence.unavailableRows, mgmt.evidence.unavailableValue, and mgmt.evidence.pager.{previous,next,pageFmt}.

Added unit and component tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/managementConsoleReads.test.ts, src/management/pages/phase2/KnowledgeInbox.test.tsx, src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/management.test.ts, and src/management/pages/oversight/EvidenceExplorerPage.test.tsx using the real BFF payload shapes.
not_changed: Left all four NonProductionActionButton promote/dismiss buttons (status="no executing owner") in src/management/pages/phase2/KnowledgeInbox.tsx untouched.
Did not weaken, delete, or alter any existing test assertion.
